createAndInitialize(uint256[],address[],.details: Creates and initializes a new OpenAccount instance. Deploys a minimal ERC-1967 proxy clone using CREATE2 for deterministic addresses. The proxy delegates all calls to the implementation contract and maintains its own storage. If an account at the predicted address already exists, returns that address without redeploying.

implementation().details: Returns the OpenAccount implementation contract address. This is the logic contract that all created proxy clones will delegate to.

predictAddress(uint256[],address[],bytes.details: Predicts the address of an OpenAccount before it is created. The address is deterministically computed based on the initialization parameters and salt. Each account is deployed as an ERC-1967 proxy clone.

function (uint256[] memory,address[] memory,bytes memory[] memory,Mode,bytes memory) external

documentation.text:
@dev Creates and initializes a new OpenAccount instance.
 Deploys a minimal ERC-1967 proxy clone using CREATE2 for deterministic addresses.
 The proxy delegates all calls to the implementation contract and maintains its own storage.
 If an account at the predicted address already exists, returns that address without redeploying.

@dev A factory contract to create OpenAccount instances on demand.
 Each account is created as a minimal ERC-1967 proxy clone that delegates to the implementation contract.
 The proxy follows the ERC-1967 standard for proxy storage slots, storing the implementation address at
 `bytes32(uint256(keccak256('eip1967.proxy.implementation')) - 1)`.
 See https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-1967 for the full specification.
